text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса gets injured during
training, so I
bring her to the infirmary.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh, come on. You're worrying too much,
Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Something like this is no big deal!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I just need a little medicine, and I can
get right
back to training!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: You know, rest is the strongest medicine.
Let's hurry up and muscle through it!

text_block_list.text: Hm... I guess that's true...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
But isn't there some kind of training I
can do
without affecting my injury?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: You really want to train that bad, huh?

text_block_list.text:
Of course! I need training like a fish
needs water!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list:
But if your injury gets worse, you're going to
need to rest even more.

text_block_list.text: I definitely don't want that... Ugh...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
All right, I get it. But as soon as I'm
better, I'm
jumping back into the ring.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! Gutsy moves are my
specialty!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Urgh! Aguántate, El! You can do this!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса hypes herself up and
tries to
move, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ouch!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Really?! My muscles are failing me now?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Ugh... I can't do this.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! Gutsy moves are my
specialty!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Urgh! Aguántate, El! You can do this!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса hypes herself up and
tries to
move...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh? The pain is gone...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Oh! Estupendo! I muscled through it!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
All right, I can finish up training like this
no
problem!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса shows incredible
resilience and is
ready to get back to
training the next day.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It seems like spirit and muscles alone
aren't
getting her anywhere. She uses
the day for some
much needed rest.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After a few days of rest, Эль Кондор Паса
is ready
to get back to training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
